text: Which zinc-coordinating transcription factors on chromosome 19 have the nucleoplasm as their main location and are expressed in every tissue?
plan: Protein class: Transcription factors / Zinc-coordinating DNA-binding domains AND Chromosome: 19 AND Subcellular location (ICC): Nucleoplasm / Main location AND Tissue category (RNA): any / Detected in all
understanding: The query asks for genes that are zinc-coordinating transcription factors, located on chromosome 19, localized to the nucleoplasm as their main subcellular location, and expressed across all tissues.

trail.why: The requirement specifically asks for zinc-coordinating transcription factors, which corresponds to the 'Transcription factors' class and the 'Zinc-coordinating DNA-binding domains' subclass.
The requirement specifies genes located on chromosome 19.
The requirement specifies the nucleoplasm as the main location, matching the Level 1 location 'Nucleoplasm' and the Level 2 annotation class 'Main location'.
The definition of 'Detected in all' is detected in every tissue, region or cell type of the dataset, with level 1 left unrestricted to apply across all tissues.

requirements.why: Identifies transcription factors and their subclasses (such as zinc-coordinating TFs) under gene classes.
Filters by the chromosome carrying the gene.
Directly filters for proteins where the nucleoplasm is observed as a main subcellular location by immunofluorescence.
Classifies RNA distribution and specificity across tissues, which defines ubiquitously expressed genes (e.g., expressed in all tissues).
